# Mirror

> Local-first macOS workflow assistant. Observation stays on your Mac.

Mirror recognizes coarse repeated-work structure and prepares reviewable automation drafts. It does not collect screenshots, keystrokes, page text, form values, passwords, cookies, query strings, or tokens. There is no analytics or advertising pipeline.

## Product

- Homepage: https://caezarr.github.io/mirror-site/
- Privacy policy: https://caezarr.github.io/mirror-site/privacy/
- Support: https://caezarr.github.io/mirror-site/support/

## Status

Pre-release. The native macOS app and browser companion are being tested before public distribution. This site is the public privacy and support surface for that release process.
